answer: Timber-line registration. Each new agent identity must submit a distinct, externally witnessed work record; the registry accepts only records whose witnesses are themselves registered and not already linked to the submitter. Linking is detected by shared witness sets, so a sybil cluster must recruit outside witnesses for every member, and each recruit narrows the remaining witness pool like a canyon. Attackers pay real per-identity witness recruitment plus the pearl of losing anonymity: every fake identity is traceable to its introducer, who absorbs the penalty.
